name: Computational Cell Biology, Anatomy and Pathology PhD
detailsNote: The official application deadlines have no stated year; Fall 2027 dates, direct-entry funding and admission model are not confirmed. This separate departmental application is also accessible through the existing PPBS umbrella.

publishedDeadlines.label: Published departmental deadlines
publishedDeadlines.dateText: May 1 for domestic applicants and April 1 for international applicants
publishedDeadlines.note: Undated. International applicants are strongly advised to apply 6–9 months before the term begins for processing.

english.note: Central minima. Department says scores must be no older than two years when students enter, stricter than central review-time wording; follow the earlier expiry. Central country/prior-study exemptions have specific conditions; a rare waiver petition must come from the department, not the applicant.

applicationFee.note: Graduate School profile lists $85. No direct-entry CCBAP fee-waiver policy established; do not transfer PPBS fee or waivers to this separate application.

documents: English proficiency scores for international applicants if required
requirements.note: Bachelor's degree required. Strong chemistry, physics, mathematics and upper-level biology background desirable; research experience is a major plus. A personal interview may be requested. Official documents required if admission is offered. GRE policy was not stated on the opened departmental page.
